cooldown.binNote: Base cooldown is a flat 14 at every rank per the bin (WAttackSpeedCDMax=0.57142 matches the 62.5%->? no, matches ~57% max reduction not 62.5%; wiki's quoted 'static' formula reduces effective cooldown from 14 down to as low as 6 with bonus attack speed, capped at 62.5% reduction per WAttackSpeedCDPercent=0.6/WAttackSpeedCDMax=0.57142). This is a dynamic, attack-speed-driven reduction, not a per-rank value; recorded as a mechanic as well.

castTime.binNote: Base cast time is 0.5 (YoneW.WBaseCastTime=0.5). It is reduced by bonus attack speed per YoneW.WAttackSpeedCastReductionPercent=0.41667 / WAttackSpeedCastReductionMax=0.5, down to a floor around 0.1875-0.25; this is a continuous attack-speed-driven reduction rather than a per-rank number, also recorded as a mechanic.

YoneW#WShield reads a by-level base of 40..90, matching the wiki's per-level formula exactly (40 at level 1, 90 at level 18). YoneW.BaseShield=[10/20/30/40/50] (by rank) is not what WShield actually uses and disagrees with the wiki, which describes the shield as scaling by champion level, not by ability rank; BaseShield looks stale.
